title: Goldreich–Levin sample count bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $0<\tau\le1$. The estimator sample count at accuracy $\tau^2/4$ and confidence parameter $1/[40(n+1)(\mathrm{cap}(\tau)+1)]$, where $\mathrm{cap}(\tau)=\left\lceil4/\tau^2\right\rceil$, when regarded as a rational number, is at most $5120(n+1)(\mathrm{cap}(\tau)+1)/\tau^4$.
